Name: Treasury Farm
Author: DonCami
Description:
I created this mod inspired by [b]Giga Farm[/b] by [i]Draylon[/i] and [b]Small Beach Farm[/b] by [i]Pathoschild[/i] — please don’t kill me 😅

This farm map is [b]155 × 155 tiles[/b], which gives it approximately [b]23,300 farmable tiles[/b].
By recent update with two optional extensions of equal size. About [b]70,000 farmable tiles.[/b]
For comparison, the base [b]Standard Farm[/b] has only about [b]3,500 farmable tiles[/b].
If you encounter any issues, feel free to let me know in the [b]Posts[/b] section.
 
[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

This mod should be compatible with almost everything.
The only possible exceptions are some [b]recolor mods[/b], where the waterfall might not be recolored correctly. If that happens, let me know and I’ll contact the recolor author to help make a compatible version.
It should also be [b]fully compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b].

[b][size=4]How to use[/size]

New save[/b]

[list]
[*]On the character creation screen, click the arrow next to the farm type list.
[*]Select [b]Treasury Farm[/b] (it will be the [b]last option[/b] in the list).
[/list][b]Existing save
[/b]
You can convert an existing save by doing the following:

[list=1]
[*]Load your save.
[*]Enter this command in the SMAPI console.
[/list][code] set_farm_type DonCami.TreasuryFarm[/code]

[b][size=4]Map entrances[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Backwoods entrance[/b]: Upper-left (north-western), between the house and the Greenhouse.
[*][b]Bus stop entrance[/b]: Upper-right (north-eastern). Exit your farmhouse and walk all the way to the right.
[*][b]Cindersap Forest entrance[/b]: South-eastern area, near the bottom-right corner of the map.
I’ll be uploading updates occasionally.This is my [b]first mod[/b], so I’m still learning — please be patient if you run into issues. I’ll make sure to address them as soon as possible.[/list]
[b]
